For A: a workflow test plus a live check that two develop merges within 5 minutes both end with dist-<sha>-attempt-N. For B: tests that admit and trunk-uat select the newest dist-bearing commit and fail clearly otherwise, plus a live run

context: Member of batch release-v2-remediation; ready now and runs alongside rv2r-01. GUARDRAILS: keep pending-run replacement for the test jobs; do not change dist build steps or artifact names. DECISION GATE: if the extra cost exceeds 60 runner-minutes per day, stop and ask the owner before choosing A.
description: Since 2026-10-28, 42 of 100 trunk runs were cancelled. They were replaced while waiting under trunk.yml's workflow-level concurrency group `trunk-develop` (cancel-in-progress: false; trunk.yml:21-23). A commit without a trunk dist artifact cannot be released (release-artifacts.md:8-11), and trunk UAT (rv2r-02) also needs a dist. Choose and implement one approach. (A) Build the dist in a separate push-triggered workflow without a replacing concurrency group (adds one workflow; rv2r-12 counts it), or move the workflow-level concurrency to the test jobs only, so the dist job is never replaced. (B) Make admit and trunk UAT select the newest commit that has a dist, with a clear error otherwise, and document that rule. Measure runner cost before choosing. The choice fixes the dist-selection rule that rv2r-02 and rv2r-03 implement. Rollback: revert this member's commits.
